parameters.content:
## 1. Intake

Webhook A accepts the §3.1 payload from the storefront (form **and** chat intake converge here).

**Ack 200 responds immediately** — adjudication continues after the response, so the storefront never waits.

**CORS:** `Allowed Origins` is `*` so the demo HTML can post from `file://` or any host. Tighten it for anything real.

## 2. Adjudicate

POSTs the payload to the FastAPI service and gets back the verdict, lane, cited clauses, case file and a drafted email.

**Edit the base URL in the `Config` node only** — every other node reads it from there.

- n8n in Docker → `http://host.docker.internal:8000`
- n8n on the host → `http://localhost:8000`

## 3. AUTO lane (Clause 12.4)

Verdict email goes out immediately with its clause citations.

The decision log row is already written by the service (Clause 15.1) — the Sheets node is an optional mirror for people who want the digest in a spreadsheet. It is **disabled**; enable it only after connecting Google credentials.

## 4. HUMAN_REVIEW lane (Clauses 12.4, 12.5)

Holding email first — under no circumstances may a final verdict reach the customer while the case awaits review.

The admin case email carries the full case file, the system proposal and one-click approve/amend links. Each link resumes **this paused execution**.

⚠️ The Wait node's resume URL only works when the workflow is **Active**. In test mode use the test URL and keep the tab open.

## 5. Close the loop (Clause 15.2)

`Record outcome` appends a *new* row to the decision log — the engine's original proposal is never rewritten, so the divergence stays auditable.

`Draft final email` asks the service for copy matching the verdict the human chose. n8n never writes customer copy: clause filtering (15.3) and the one-recourse rule (16.2) live in the service.

## Daily FYI digest — Clause 12.5

Auto-lane verdicts are compiled into a daily digest to the Returns Desk; **no action required**.

It also carries the Clause 15.2 control: if adjudicators amended more than 10% of system proposals in the rolling window, the digest says so in red and the policy-engine owner owes a divergence review.

Set the same `adjudicatorUrl` you used in the main workflow.
